questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question_text: In the given figure, if PT is a tangent to a circle with centre O and $\angle TPO = 35°$, then the measure of $\angle x$ is:
questions.question_text_hindi: दी गई आकृति में, केंद्र O वाले वृत्त की एक स्पर्श-रेखा PT यदि इस प्रकार है कि $\angle TPO = 35°$, तो $\angle x$ की माप है:
questions.solution_text: Since PT is tangent, $OT \perp PT$, so $\angle OTP = 90°$. In $\triangle OTP$: $\angle TOP = 180° - 90° - 35° = 55°$. Reflex angle at centre gives $\angle x = 90° + 35° = 125°$.

sub_questions.question_text: Find a relation between x and y such that the point P(x, y) is equidistant from the points A(7, 1) and B(3, 5).
sub_questions.question_text_hindi: यदि बिंदु P(x, y), बिंदुओं A(7, 1) तथा B(3, 5) से समदूरस्थ है, तो x तथा y के बीच का संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए।

sub_questions.question_text: Points A(–1, y) and B(5, 7) lie on a circle with centre O(2, –3y) such that AB is a diameter. Find the value of y. Also find the radius.
sub_questions.question_text_hindi: बिंदु A(–1, y) तथा B(5, 7), केंद्र O(2, –3y) वाले वृत्त पर स्थित हैं तथा AB व्यास है। y का मान तथा त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।

key_points: O is midpoint of AB: y = -1

sub_questions.solution_text: O is midpoint of AB: $\frac{y+7}{2} = -3y \Rightarrow y = -1$. Centre $O = (2, 3)$. Radius $= \sqrt{(5-2)^2+(7-3)^2} = 5$.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.question_text: Teaching Mathematics through activities is a powerful approach. Ms. Mukta planned a prime number game for class 5 students. She announced the number 2 and asked the first student to multiply it by a prime number and pass it on. In this way the last student got 173250.
questions.question_text_hindi: गतिविधियों के माध्यम से गणित पढ़ाना एक शक्तिशाली दृष्टिकोण है। सुश्री मुक्ता ने संख्या 2 से शुरू करके अंतिम छात्र तक 173250 प्राप्त किया।

sub_questions.question_text: What is the least prime number used by students?
sub_questions.question_text_hindi: छात्रों द्वारा प्रयोग की गई सबसे छोटी अभाज्य संख्या कौन सी है?
sub_questions.solution_text: The least prime factor in $173250 = 2 \times 3^2 \times 5^3 \times 7 \times 11$ is $2$.

sub_questions.question_text: Which prime number has been used maximum times?
sub_questions.question_text_hindi: कौन सी अभाज्य संख्या अधिकतम बार प्रयोग की गई है?

sub_questions.question_text: How many students are in the class?
sub_questions.solution_text: Total prime factors with multiplicity $= 1+2+3+1+1 = 8$. Starting number is $2$, so students $= 8-1 = 7$.
